admissions.name: requests
admissions.scope: HTTP transport used by existing OKX client; not a trading bot or strategy framework.
constraints: No order submission outside OKXBridge.live_test gate

admissions.name: httpx
admissions.scope: HTTP transport for API clients and tests.
constraints: No exchange-specific order path unless wrapped by an adapter gate

admissions.name: websockets
constraints: Market data must normalize into crypto PIT rows before research use

admissions.name: ccxt
admissions.scope: Drop-in OKX market data + order adapter. XAR-423 spike proved schema compatibility; XAR-426 promoted to production default via KATANA_OKX_ADAPTER=ccxt.
constraints: No private order methods exposed to research
All outputs must pass crypto PIT contracts
Order submission only via OKXBridge live_test gate (katana_gate_token enforced)

admissions.name: python-okx
admissions.scope: OKX-native PIT depth endpoints (funding rate history, open interest, mark price). XAR-423 spike proved all required fields present. Used only from okx_ccxt_adapter.py and okx_pit_writer.py.
constraints: Public data endpoints only (no auth methods exposed to research)
All outputs must pass crypto PIT contracts via validate_pit_invariants()

admissions.name: freqtrade
admissions.scope: May be read for operational ideas; must not become the runtime strategy engine.
constraints: Do not import into production code
Do not reuse live execution layer

admissions.name: hummingbot
admissions.scope: May be read for connector and market-making patterns.
constraints: Do not import into production code
Do not reuse custody or live execution layer
